original_target.title: A strongly polynomial pivot rule for the simplex method

scope_comparison: Current circuit-diameter/straight-line-complexity results use circuit augmentations rather than ordinary feasible simplex pivots, and do not provide the target rule-selection arithmetic bound. Bounds on degenerate pivots alone do not bound all pivots; special unimodular/network LP or deterministic games are restricted inputs. No admissible general strongly-polynomial pivot algorithm located.
